## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build` is green
- [ ] A change a user of a package can see has a changeset (`pnpm changeset`)
- [ ] A rule that changes keeps its frontmatter valid, and its review verdict is set by the maintainer
- [ ] A new term used on the site is in the glossary
